issues.description: New commands use plural form, breaking the singular quickmark-*/bookmark-* naming convention
issues.detail: Methods are registered as quickmarks_reload/bookmarks_reload, exposed as :quickmarks-reload/:bookmarks-reload. All existing related commands use singular forms (quickmark-add, quickmark-save, bookmark-add, bookmark-del). This breaks the command vocabulary, hurts tab-completion grouping, and surprises users with muscle memory. Rename to quickmark-reload and bookmark-reload.

issues.description: reload() silently discards unsaved in-memory mark additions
issues.detail: reload() calls self.marks.clear() and re-reads from disk unconditionally. Any quickmarks/bookmarks added in-session that the save-manager hasn't flushed are silently dropped. There is no dirty-state check or user warning. Consider flushing pending saves or prompting before clobbering.

issues.description: reload() reconstructs the LineParser, potentially stranding references held elsewhere
issues.detail: reload() calls _init_lineparser() which builds a fresh LineParser each time. The save-manager and other components may hold references to the original instance, so subsequent saves could write to a detached parser. Prefer refreshing the existing self._lineparser or verify all consumers re-fetch.

issues.description: Missing changelog/doc entry for new user-facing commands
issues.detail: Two new commands are added but doc/changelog.asciidoc and the generated command docs are not updated. qutebrowser convention requires changelog entries and regenerated command docs for new commands; without them users cannot discover the feature and CI doc-checks may fail.

issues.description: Feature test scenarios are missing descriptive names
issues.detail: Both new scenarios in urlmarks.feature use bare Scenario: with no title, breaking the convention of every other scenario in the file (e.g., Scenario: Saving a quickmark). Add titles like Reloading bookmarks (:bookmarks-reload) for readability of test reports.

issues.description: Unit test coverage is thin: removal-on-reload and QuickmarkManager paths not exercised
issues.detail: test_reload only checks the replace-one-entry case on BookmarkManager. It does not verify that entries removed from the file are dropped (the key clear() semantic), does not cover QuickmarkManager (which overrides clear/_parse_line and emits per-mark removed signals), and does not test empty-file reload. Add cases to lock in these behaviors.

synthesis.summary: The PR cleanly extracts file-loading into a reusable UrlMarkManager.reload() method and exposes it via two new commands. The panel unanimously flags command naming as the top issue: the new commands use plural form (quickmarks-reload/bookmarks-reload), breaking the established singular quickmark-*/bookmark-* convention. Secondary concerns shared across reviewers: reload() silently discards unsaved in-memory changes, recreates the LineParser in a way that may strand references held by the save-manager, and lacks changelog/doc updates. Test coverage is thin — feature scenarios lack titles, and unit tests do not exercise removal-on-reload or QuickmarkManager. Rename the commands, add unsaved-state handling, refresh rather than replace the lineparser, and broaden tests/docs before merge.
